data.long_meaning: The name Ernesto is derived from the Old Germanic words eran (to earn) and stan (to stand or make to stand). It means 'to serve the earnest' or 'to serve the steadfast'. In Christian tradition, it is a name given to those who are devoted and steadfast in their faith. The name Ernesto carries the meaning “Serve the Earnest” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Ernesto usually hope their child will grow to embody serve the earnest and live with faith, good character and purpose.
